title: Send a Gmail draft with AI after checking its contents
h1: ask ai to send the gmail draft you already checked
description: Send a saved Gmail draft after checking its recipients, text and cc or bcc. Keep each send under review with the right sending setting.
answer: **finish the proposal in gmail, then release it when the client says yes.** the bot sends the saved draft to its saved recipients, including cc and bcc. it uses the text exactly as it stands. open that copy before allowing the send; edits in chat need a separate draft update.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: your finished draft, ready to release.
what:
**write it once in gmail. send that exact copy from chat.** use a draft you wrote yourself or one a bot prepared earlier. ask it to list drafts and open the match.

the saved to, cc and bcc decide who receives it. update a wrong address or sentence separately, then read the saved email. sending asks by default unless you allow a daily amount.
uses: send a proposal you finished in gmail once the customer confirms the deadline
send the venue confirmation after checking its booking reference
release an introduction after both people agree

routine.message: every weekday at 4, list gmail drafts whose subject starts with "ready:". show each draft's to, cc, bcc and full text here. ask before each send. send only the copies i allow, exactly as saved. if several drafts fit, ask which i mean. never rewrite a draft or send one i have not seen.
routine.needs: gmail with read and write; sending set to ask every time
routine.output:
1 ready draft
subject: ready: orchard quay venue confirmation
to: nina@orchardquay.example
cc: none
bcc: none

we confirm the room booking for the agreed date. please keep the entrance clear for our equipment.

send this saved copy?

steps: connect gmail and give the bot read and write access.
allow listing and opening drafts alongside sending. it needs to show you the saved email.
set **Sending on your behalf** to **Ask every time**. test with a draft addressed to yourself.
read the saved copy, then allow the send. **Pause** stops the daily ready-draft review.
watch: careful with **Full access**: a bot there with no sending rule can send up to 25 a day without asking. give it **Ask every time**.
**save your correction into the draft.** a correction in chat alone leaves the gmail copy unchanged.
**same subject, different drafts.** ask the bot to show both and let you choose.

faq.q: can it change the recipient when it sends the draft?
faq.a: **change it before the send.** this action uses the saved recipient list. update the draft and read it again first.

faq.q: how does it know which draft i mean?
faq.a: **name the subject and account.** the bot lists drafts and opens the match. if two fit, ask it to show both.

steps: set gmail sending to ask every time
ask the bot to open a draft addressed to you
read its full text, to, cc and bcc
allow that saved copy to send

mistakes.mistake: fixing an address only in chat
mistakes.fix: ask for a draft update, then inspect the saved address.

mistakes.mistake: leaving bcc out of the preview
mistakes.fix: show all three recipient lists. hidden recipients still receive the email.

tip.text: read the draft in gmail if anything changed since your last preview.

items: the account and draft match your intent
to, cc and bcc contain only intended recipients
the saved text includes your latest edits
